Excellent! All 77 tests pass. I've successfully added plain-text invoice rendering:

✅ **`src/render.js`** with `renderInvoiceText(invoice)`:
- Returns formatted plain-text invoice with:
  - First line: invoice number (or "DRAFT" if not issued)
  - Second line: customer name
  - One line per line item: `qty x name @ unitPrice = lineTotal`
  - Last line: `Total: <total amount>`
- All amounts formatted using `formatEuros()` from `src/money.js`
- Handles missing customers gracefully with fallback

✅ **11 new tests** covering:
- Draft and issued invoices
- Customer name display
- Euro formatting
- Line item details
- Multiple lines
- Total calculation
- Missing customer handling
- Integration with invoice modifications
- Output structure verification
